description:
Hello,

This is a 1 hour long photoshoot in Paris. You get all the pics I took of you within 24 hours.

We can meet at any location of your choice. If you're not familiar with Paris, I can also pick the place for you.

I will be snapping shots away at your every move, your every smile while you're out there just existing in Paris. We can go for a sophisticated fashion style kind of shooting or some more relaxed and natural candid stuff.
hostdescription: I worked at a fashion studio in Seoul, South Korea. I usually work with models but also like doing some street style photography when my schedule allows it. I tend to bother a lot of people on the streets of Paris to take their picture :)

reviews.text: Theo was really nice, and accommodating. The whole experience was fun. I kept having problem with my hair and even hurt my feet a little but he waited patiently. Theo also sent me all the pictures from the session which are all amazing! Thank you for making this fun and enjoyable experience, Theo! I definitely recommend him!

I had a wonderful shoot with Theo! I'm not comfortable in front of the camera, but he helped me to feel relaxed and natural. He found great locations and was flexible as we went along. I also don't normally like pictures of me taken by others, however he got some gorgeous shots. I definitely recommend booking Theo if you are in Paris.

My experience with Theo was amazing. He was super nice and accommodating. I’m not too good in front of a camera but Theo made sure to guide me throughout the whole session. He made me so comfortable that at times I completely forgot about the camera. I would definitely book him again.
if u want a photoshoot done in Paris ,definitely go with him without a doubt. he makes you feel comfortable and suggests beautiful spots. great work.

I booked this photo session for my mum. Theo made the whole experience a fun and unforgettable day for my Mum. We have now lovely photos that we will treasure. We found Theo very friendly but professional and considerate as he made sure that she felt comfortable at all times. I would definitely recommend.
